item.description: ২০২৬ সালের জুনিয়র বৃত্তি পরীক্ষার বাংলাদেশ ও বিশ্বপরিচয় বিষয়ের ষষ্ঠ অধ্যায়ের ওপর সংক্ষিপ্ত প্রশ্ন প্রকাশ করা হয়েছে। এতে বাংলার সংগীত ঐতিহ্য সংক্রান্ত বিভিন্ন গুরুত্বপূর্ণ বিষয় তুলে ধরা হয়েছে।

item.title: Palakkad Lynching: Seven Detained as Authorities Seek More Suspects

item.title: Telangana Seeks Bids to Excavate Mudumal's Ancient Solar-Aligned Menhirs

item.description: OpenAI dismissed a worker after discovering a recording device inside a meeting space. The AI firm utilized its own technology to analyze the equipment and trace its origin.

item.description: The official revocation of Jantar Mantar as a designated demonstration area has sparked backlash from critics and opposition groups, who view it as an infringement on free assembly.

item.title: Gas Essential for Australia's Near-Term Industry, Says Minister
item.description: Resources Minister Madeleine King stated that the domestic sector will depend on natural gas for a long time. She noted that a planned gas reservation policy starting in 2028 aims to lower electricity costs.

item.title: Vijayawada Hotels Experience Low Bookings During Festival Season
item.description: Despite large crowds arriving for Dasara and two additional events, local hoteliers report poor room occupancy. Most worshippers choose to travel back home by nightfall rather than book overnight accommodations.

item.title: Aston Villa Faces Questions Over Stadium Construction Impact

item.title: UK Analysis Highlights Persistence of Channel Boat Crossings
